headers.//: Everything except the root. `/:path+` matches one or more path segments, so the marketing page below is deliberately excluded. The dashboard and the Xero OAuth flow stay unframable: framing an authenticated financial integration is a clickjacking route.

The public marketing page only. X-Frame-Options is omitted rather than overridden: it has no allowlist syntax, and where both headers are present browsers may honour the stricter one. Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors is its modern replacement and takes an explicit allowlist. Nothing here is authenticated, so the exposure is a public landing page rendering inside a named origin.
